foreground.tooltip: Straight (un-premultiplied) foreground, sRGB or linear (see colorspace).

alpha.tooltip: Matte, 1 = subject. 1 mask or one per frame; resized to the foreground.

background_mode.tooltip: checker: review checkerboard. solid: solid_color. image: the background input.

light_wrap_size.tooltip: How far (pixels) background light reaches into the subject's edge.

light_wrap_intensity.tooltip: Amount of blurred background added onto the subject's edge. 0 = off.

premultiply.tooltip: rgba output: multiply the color by alpha (premultiplied, as compositing apps expect for premultiplied files). Off: straight color.

colorspace.tooltip: sRGB: the foreground, background plate and composite are display sRGB. linear: they are scene-linear and unclamped, as from the Advanced keyer with output_colorspace linear (save with Save Image (Advanced) as EXR, input_color_space linear). Checker and solid_color are converted for you.

background.tooltip: Background plate for background_mode 'image': 1 frame or a clip, resized to the foreground. A shorter clip holds its last frame.

output_tooltips: Foreground over the background, in the chosen colorspace.
Foreground color with alpha as a 4th channel.
CorridorKey2Composite.name: CorridorKey2Composite
CorridorKey2Composite.description: Places a straight foreground over a checkerboard, a solid color or a background plate, blended in linear light, with optional light wrap. Also outputs the foreground as RGBA.
